explanation: A context-depth dial that is mostly blind to content: the pole stays weak (under about 0.15 of max) on the first ~10 tokens of any text, and from about the 20th token it goes above a quarter of max on ordinary tokens of any kind (English prose, code, numbers, non-Latin script), so almost any probe of 20+ tokens is predicted active and almost any probe under ~10 tokens inactive. Content only decides which tokens of a long text peak: the strongest values (above 0.7 of max) come only hundreds of tokens into a document, on numerals, operators, LaTeX or markup symbols and indentation in dense math or code, or on mid-word byte pieces of non-Latin scripts, while common English function words stay at the low end.
